description:
[PAID] Rank teams by how overdue a draw is — the question this database exists to answer.

Every team has a historical draw rate and a run of matches since its last draw. When
the run is long relative to how often that team normally draws, the team is carrying
"draw debt", and this tool ranks the whole field by it, most overdue first. Ask it
"which national teams are most due a draw?" or "who is overdue a draw in the World
Cup 2026 field?" and it answers directly; nothing else here needs to be queried first.

Each entry returns the rank, the score, and the signals behind it: matches played,
draws, draw percentage, the current no-draw streak, the longest ever, and the debt
figure. Filters subset which teams are listed — a team's score and rank are global and
never change with them. Historical pattern, not a betting tip.

Costs 1 point per call (1 point = 1 cent); paginated calls cost 1 point per page.

limit.description: How many ranked teams to return. Default 25, max 500. One call, one point, whatever the limit.

recent.description: Only teams with a recent match, so the answer is about teams currently playing. Default true.

type.description: Restrict the ranking to national teams or to clubs. Omit to rank both together.

wc2026.description: Restrict to the 2026 World Cup team group. Default false.

name: predict_draws

data.description: Teams ranked by how overdue a draw is, most overdue first.

last_match_date.description: Date of the team's most recent match.

rank.description: Position in the ranking; 1 is the most overdue.

score.description: The draw-likelihood score the ranking sorts on.

signals.description: The figures the score is built from.

draw_debt.description: Draws expected from the draw rate minus draws that came.

draw_pct.description: Share of matches drawn, in percent.

max_no_draw_streak.description: Longest run without a draw, ever.

country.description: The country a team or competition belongs to.

exists_now.description: False for a team that no longer exists.

full_name.description: Official or long name, when known.

id.description: Team id — the argument every team tool takes.

slug.description: URL slug; accepted anywhere an id is.

title: Teams most overdue a draw
